# FacultyKart

> FacultyKart (https://facultykart.in) is India's premier faculty hiring and recruitment marketplace. It connects coaching institutes, test-prep academies, schools, and colleges with KYC-verified teaching professionals for IIT-JEE, NEET, Foundation, Olympiads, and K-12 (CBSE, ICSE, State Boards).

## What FacultyKart Does
- **For Institutes:** Coaching institutes post teaching vacancies with specific subjects, batches, exams, board, expected salary, and urgency. Institutes manage candidates through a structured ATS pipeline: Applied → Under Review → Shortlisted → Interview / Demo → Selected / Rejected.
- **For Teachers:** Educators create detailed profiles, upload resumes, academic credentials, and demo video lectures, and apply to vacancies 100% free of charge.
- **Whiteboard Trial Lectures:** Institutes schedule video whiteboard demo lectures directly through the platform (specifying date, time, topic, and meeting link).
- **Privacy-First Unlocking:** Teacher phone numbers, email addresses, and original CVs remain masked until an institute pays a nominal one-time unlock fee (₹49 via Razorpay).
- **Credential Verification:** A human moderation and background-check team audits teacher degrees, experience letters, and IDs, awarding the Verified Faculty badge within 24–48 hours.

## Key Facts
- **Website & Domain:** https://facultykart.in
- **Pricing:** Free for teachers. Institutes pay only ₹49 per candidate profile unlock.
- **Coverage Hubs:** All over India, with major recruitment activity in Kota, Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Pune, and Lucknow.
- **Academic Subjects:** Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology (Botany & Zoology), English, Social Sciences, Computer Science, and Foundation Olympiad sciences.
- **Levels Covered:** JEE Main & Advanced, NEET-UG, NTSE, KVPY, Olympiads, Class 9–12 Board Exams.
